name: anki-multidefine-mcp
description: Look up words in monolingual dictionaries (Oxford, DWDS, Wiktionary, Larousse) and add them to Anki as flashcards.
long_description:
MultiDefine for Anki connects Claude to five monolingual dictionaries. Ask Claude to add a word to your Anki deck and it looks up the definition, downloads audio, formats the card, and creates the note — all in one message.

Supports English (Oxford Learner's), German (DWDS), Russian (ru.Wiktionary), French (Larousse), and Azerbaijani (AZLEKS).

Requires the AnkiConnect Anki add-on (code 2055492827) and the MultiDefine Anki add-on to be installed, and the Anki MCP server to also be configured in Claude Desktop.

tools.name: define
tools.description: Look up a word in a monolingual dictionary. Returns definitions, IPA, audio URL, and verb forms.
